correctness.rationale: Reflecting the position after each run gives decreasing contractions G_m(z)=−1+q^m(1−z), so the positive-start return map is F_mn=G_n∘G_m. The attractor for {G₁,G₂} is also the attractor of its twofold composition by uniqueness. On the stated hull I, G₂(h)=ℓ and G₁(ℓ)=h, and G₂<G₁ pointwise. The interval gap G₁(h)−G₂(ℓ)=2q(1−q−q²)/(1+q+q²) is positive precisely below φ⁻¹. It gives strict separation there, single-endpoint contact at equality, and interval coverage thereafter. Independent exact algebra also verifies the three four-map signed gaps and canonical q=1/2 intervals. The middle two images need not have ordered left endpoints above threshold, but the reverse overlap inequality F₁₁(h)−F₂₂(ℓ)=2q(q⁴−q+1)/(1+q+q²)>0 confirms that the stated chain covers the hull. The similarities satisfy (q^s+q^{2s})²=1 and the iid equally weighted pair has entropy log 4 and Lyapunov exponent 3 log(1/q), giving the two distinct dimensions under strong separation. In equilibrium physical time, each two-run cycle of mean 3τ starts in the embedded stationary law; each of its two monotone runs has normalized speed at least 2κq²/(1+q+q²)>0. Occupation time in a set is therefore bounded by a constant times its length, yielding an essentially bounded physical-time density independently of the event measure's regularity.
residual_risks: The dimension of the switching measure is asserted only in the strict separation regime; interval support above it does not imply a density. Physical time here means equilibrium phase or long-run occupation, not a synchronized lattice-time marginal.

checked_sources: Farago–Smith arXiv:2401.01576v2, Sections III.B and V
value.rationale: The two binary dwell times give a natural test of event-sampled versus time-sampled steady-state data in a standard trapped-particle model. The exact boundary, the separate measure and support dimensions, and a speed-based density bound quantify a failure of physical-time measurements to reveal singular switching geometry. This is a complete benchmark for this clock, not just an isolated fractal example.
residual_risks: No theorem for other duration ratios, for Brownian translational noise, or for switching-measure regularity in the overlap regime.
